City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
DECEMBER 9, 2014
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Lewis, Holloway, Argudo, Klinakis and Muñoz
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of Sunset Elementary, Workman Elementary and Sparks Middle School students attending the City Council Meeting
Recognition of Main Street Run Winners
Recognition of Outgoing Planning Commissioner Greg Young
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN URGENCY ORDINANCE ADOPTING A CITYWIDE MORATORIUM ON THE ESTABLISHMENT, EXPANSION OR RELOCATION OF NEW AND EXISTING MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS AND MASSAGE TECHNICIANS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No. 14-933 approving a temporary moratorium on the establishment, expansion or relocation of new and existing massage establishments and massage technicians in the City.
Agenda Item No. E- 1 Massage Moratorium - Urgency Ordinance
E-
2 CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION REAFFIRMING THE CITY'S COMMITMENT TO MAINTAINING AND IMPROVING THE QUALITY OF LIFE THROUGHOUT THE CITY'S NEIGHBORHOODS AND COMMERCIAL AND INDUSTRIAL CORRIDORS, AND TO FURTHER ENHANCE THE OPERATIONS OF THE CITY'S CODE ENFORCEMENT PROGRAM
It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution No. 14-5179 reaffirming the City's commitment to maintaining and improving the quality of life throughout the City's neighborhoods and commercial and industrial corridors, and to further enhance the operations of the City's Code Enforcement program.
Agenda Item No. E-2 Code Enforcement
E-3
CONSIDERATION AND POSSIBLE ACTION REGARDING A REQUEST FROM MR. S. CLAUS FOR VARIANCES FROM THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE
It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution No. 14-5180:
1) Granting a free business license for a non-profit organization (LPMC 5.04.180);
2) Waiving the Noise Ordinance to permit the sound of bells (LPMC 7-2-3);
3) Waiving the Trespass Ordinance (LPMC 3.16.130);
4) Waiving the ordinance on Animal Regulations (LPMC 10.68.010); or
5) Alternatively discuss and take other action regarding this item.
Agenda Item No. E-3 Santa Claus
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF NOVEMBER 12, 2014
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council meeting of November 12, 2014.
Agenda Item No. A-1 Minutes 11-12-14 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - NONE
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - NONE
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1376 AND 27
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 14-5175 approving Warrant Register No. 1376 and Resolution No. SA 14-43 approving Warrant Register No. 27.
Agenda Item No. D-1 Warrant No. 1376 & No. 27
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION RECOGNIZING THE IMPORTANCE OF THE IN-HOME CARE PROVIDER WORKFORCE AND NOVEMBER AS NATIONAL FAMILY CAREGIVERS MONTH
It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution No. 14-5176 recognizing the importance of the in-home care provider workforce and November as National Family Caregivers Month.
Agenda Item No. D-2 Family Caregivers Month
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION CASTING THE CITY'S VOTES FOR A CITY COUNCIL MEMBER TO REPRESENT CITIES WITHOUT PRESCRIPTIVE WATER PUMPING RIGHTS ON THE BOARD OF THE SAN GABRIEL BASIN WATER QUALITY AUTHORITY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 14-5177 casting the City's votes for Louie Aguinaga, Mayor of South El Monte, to represent cities without prescriptive water pumping rights on the Board of the San Gabriel Basin Water Quality Authority.
Agenda Item No. D-3 WQA Board Member
D-4
PRESENTATION AND DISCUSSION REGARDING THE FIRST QUARTER INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
Agenda Item No. D-4 First Quarter Investment Report - FY 14-15
D-5
PRESENTATION AND DISCUSSION REGARDING THE CITY'S COMPREHENSIVE ANNUAL FINANCIAL REPORT FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2014
It is recommended that the Council receive and file the City's Comprehensive Annual Financial Reports for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2014.
Agenda Item No. D-5 CAFR -2013-14
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A SETTLEMENT AND RELEASE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND JOSE GUTIERREZ FOR THE UNRUH AVENUE SPECIFIC PLAN AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF A 74 UNIT SENIOR HOUSING PROJECT LOCATED AT 1040 UNRUH AVENUE
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Settlement and Release Agreement between the City and Jose Gutierrez.
Agenda Item No. D-6 Gutierrez Agreement
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 14-5170 AND ESTABLISHING EMPLOYER PICK-UP FOR EMPLOYEE CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM ("CALPERS")
It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution No. 14-5178 rescinding Resolution No, 14-5170 and establishing the Employer Paid Member Contributions to the California Public Employees Retirement System.
Agenda Item No. D-7 CalPers Retirement
D-8
CONSIDERATION OF A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES IN THE AMOUNT OF $122,215.40 TO RESOLVE THE CITY'S PROPERTY TAX ADMINISTRATION FEES ("PTAF") CLAIM
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to approve full release and settlement on the property tax administration fees ("PTAF") claim against the County of Los Angeles in the amount of $122,215.40.
Agenda Item No. D-8 Consideration of a Settlement Agreement
AB 1234 REPORTS
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this this 4th day of December, 2014

City Clerk
